name: Buddy Punch
description_en:
Buddy Punch records employee punches and turns timecards into attendance reports and payroll-ready data. Location restrictions, scheduling and identity-related punch controls depend on plan and configuration.

Its base fee and per-user fee are separate. Administrator accounts are advertised as free, while employees using time tracking drive the user quantity. A punch record is evidence of a recorded event, not independent proof that all payable work was captured.
description_zh:
Buddy Punch 记录员工打卡，形成工时卡、考勤报告及薪资输入。地点限制、排班和身份相关打卡控制取决于档位与配置。

基础费与每用户费用分开，管理员账户宣传免费，使用时间记录的员工决定用户数量。打卡记录证明系统保存了事件，不独立证明所有应付工作已记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Review recorded punches and prepare time reports before payroll.
core_features.explanation_zh: 审核已记打卡，生成薪资前时间报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro adds offline punches that sync later and basic geofencing.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 加入后续同步的离线打卡及基础地理围栏。

en: Configure employees, jobs, pay periods, break/overtime rules and allowed locations. With an eligible plan, record an offline punch and inspect the synchronized timecard later. Compare source timestamps, edits and approval before payroll export. This is a test recommendation, not a performed punch.
zh: 配置员工、工作项、工资周期、休息/加班规则及允许地点。在适用套餐记录离线打卡，之后检查同步工时卡，导出薪资前对照原时间戳、更正及审批。这是测试建议，未实际打卡。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: User rates plus monthly base and optional add-ons; annual and monthly pricing differ, administrators advertised free.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: User rates plus monthly base and optional add-ons; annual and monthly pricing differ, administrators advertised free.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 用户费加月基础费及可选项；年付/月付不同，管理员宣传免费。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a field employee clocks in without connectivity
sections.title_zh: 示例：外勤员工断网打卡
sections.en:
Configure employees, jobs, pay periods, break/overtime rules and allowed locations. With an eligible plan, record an offline punch and inspect the synchronized timecard later. Compare source timestamps, edits and approval before payroll export. This is a test recommendation, not a performed punch.

GPS/geofencing depends on device location and permission behavior. Evaluate denied permissions and a boundary location, not just a successful office punch. Automatic breaks and rounding require business-specific review; neither a default setting nor a software label determines the correct payable time.
sections.zh:
配置员工、工作项、工资周期、休息/加班规则及允许地点。在适用套餐记录离线打卡，之后检查同步工时卡，导出薪资前对照原时间戳、更正及审批。这是测试建议，未实际打卡。

GPS/地理围栏依赖设备定位及权限，评估应包含拒绝权限和边界地点，而非只测办公室成功打卡。自动休息和取整需结合业务审查，默认设置或软件标签不能决定正确应付时间。

sections.title_en: Base fee plus employees and add-ons
sections.title_zh: 基础费加员工与附加项
sections.en:
The annual-rate view lists Starter/Pro/Advanced at $4.99/$6.99/$12.99 per user monthly equivalent plus a $19 monthly base. A separate monthly block shows $5.99/$7.99/$13.99 with the same base. Confirm currency/tax and actual checkout cadence. For ten Starter users at the lower displayed rate, arithmetic gives $68.90 before add-ons/tax; this is not a quote.

The trial is fourteen days without a card. Pro lists offline mode, geofencing and kiosk/photo options; optional add-ons are separate. Free admin users do not erase employee seat charges.
sections.zh:
年付费率视图列 Starter/Pro/Advanced 每用户月均 $4.99/$6.99/$12.99，另加每月 $19 基础费；独立月付区块为 $5.99/$7.99/$13.99，同样加基础费。货币/税费及结算周期需确认。十位 Starter 用户按较低显示费率算为 $68.90，未含附加项/税费，并非报价。

试用十四天无需卡。Pro 列出离线、地理围栏及 kiosk/照片选项，可选附加项另计。管理员免费不会取消员工席位费。

sections.title_en: Attendance is an input to payroll
sections.en:
Attendance-focused employers can evaluate this workflow; consultants needing only billable project allocation should check whether the extra punch controls are relevant. Keep a correction process for missed punches and reconcile the approved export before sending payroll.

No offline sync, GPS, biometric/photo, payroll, regulatory suitability, software licence or restoration test was performed. The product pages describe a managed service, not verified self-hosting rights.
sections.zh:
以考勤为重点的雇主可评估此流程，仅需可计费项目分配的顾问则需判断打卡控制是否相关。应保留漏打卡更正流程，发送薪资前核对已批准导出。

未测试离线同步、GPS、生物识别/照片、薪资、监管适用性、软件许可或恢复。产品页介绍托管服务，未证明自托管权。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No location/offline/identity, pay-rule calculation, export, licence or recovery test; final quote and tax require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试地点/离线/身份、工资规则计算、导出、许可或恢复；最终报价与税费需确认。
